description: This file defines data structures, constants, and function prototypes for reading and parsing Redis protocol messages, including error codes, reply types, and the redisReader API.

classes.name: redisReadTask
classes.description: Represents a task for reading a part of the Redis protocol message, including type, elements, index, and parent task.

classes.name: redisReplyObjectFunctions
classes.description: Holds function pointers for creating and freeing reply objects of various types.

classes.name: redisReader
classes.description: Main structure for reading and parsing Redis protocol data, maintaining buffer state, error info, and callback functions.

methods.name: redisReaderCreateWithFunctions
methods.description: Creates a new redisReader instance with specified reply object functions.

methods.name: redisReaderFree
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a redisReader instance.

methods.name: redisReaderFeed
methods.description: Feeds data into the redisReader for parsing.

methods.name: redisReaderGetReply
methods.description: Retrieves the parsed reply from the redisReader.
